# One bad command per argument error. Run from the repository root; {tmp} is a scratch copy of
# examples/profile.cv.txt so nothing in the repo is modified.
add bullet exp-01 "Did a thing." --weight 7 -p {tmp}
build --nope
add skill
check
validate extra
build --max-bullets 0
build --locale fr -p examples/profile.cv.txt -t templates/minimal.tex
validate -p tests/fixtures/bad/does-not-exist.cv.txt
check out/does-not-exist.tex
build -p examples/profile.cv.txt
build -p examples/profile.cv.txt -t tests/fixtures/bad/does-not-exist.tex
build -p examples/profile.cv.txt -t templates/minimal.tex --hat no-such-hat
build -p examples/profile.cv.txt -t templates/minimal.tex --job tests/fixtures/bad/no-job.txt
tailor -p examples/profile.cv.txt -t templates/minimal.tex --job examples/job.txt --rewrite
add role "Backend Developer" --org Acme --start 2024-13 -p {tmp}
add bullet exp-99 "Did a thing." -p {tmp}
add skill py "Python again" -p {tmp}
